theorem_title: Zero coefficient sum for the 8-row YAH symbol certificate
natural_language_statement:
The alphabet is the fixed seven-symbol YAH alphabet $\Sigma=\{f,t,0,1,2,\hat{},\$\}$; labeled tokens are pairs in $T=\Sigma\times\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ under the specified two-state suffix algebra. Let $C_s$ be the fixed 8-row symbol certificate. For labeled symbols $e\in T$, let $\delta(r,e)$ be its count on the local left side of row $r$ minus its count on the local right side. Then

$$\forall e\in T,\qquad\sum_{(a,r)\in C_s}a\,\delta(r,e)=0.$$

The Lean statement expresses this equality as matching coefficient lists over the complete finite feature enumeration. It supplies the cancellation identity for this particular fixed-algebra additive obstruction.
preamble:
